title: Creating/Editing a Shipment

children:
The system generates all necessary shipments when an order is interfaced 
 from the ERP. However, you may need to manually create or edit a shipment to accommodate 
 special circumstances. Shipments can be created/edited from the Shipment Insight Screen.

Converting a Shipment 
 to a Receipt
Using the Planned Shipment Insight Screen
Using the Shipment Line Insight Screen
The following is discussed in this topic:
Open the Shipment Insight Screen or the Planned Shipment Insight Screen.

Select the New 
 action. The system will display the Shipment Screen in new mode.

Enter the required fields (Shipment ID and all of the Ship 
 To address fields). In addition to shipment ID and the required Ship To fields, the Warehouse field must be populated when creating a shipment from the Shipment Insight screen.  The warehouse will be defaulted to the user’s default warehouse when opening the screen in new mode.
Press the Save button, and the system will create the shipment. If you now wish to create line(s) for this shipment, see the topic

The shipment's leading and trailing 
 status are determined by the status action value associated with the screen 
 that you're creating it on.

If you created this shipment on the Shipment Insight screen, its status is based on the value defined 
 in the "Add From Shipping" status action.

If you created this shipment on 
 the  Planned Shipment Insight screen, its status is based on the value 
 defined in the "Add From Wave" status action.

If you created this shipment 
 on the Order Entry Window, its status is based on the value defined in 
 the "Add From Order Entry" status action.
Open the Shipment Insight Screen or the Planned Shipment Insight Screen.
Access the shipment you want to edit.
Change the values of the field(s) you wish to edit.
Press the Save button The system will save your changes.

        Creating a Shipment...
        
            Open the Shipment Insight Screen or the Planned Shipment Insight Screen. 
            Select the New 
 action. The system will display the Shipment Screen in new mode.  
                  Enter the required fields (Shipment ID and all of the Ship 
 To address fields). In addition to shipment ID and the required Ship To fields, the Warehouse field must be populated when creating a shipment from the Shipment Insight screen.  The warehouse will be defaulted to the user’s default warehouse when opening the screen in new mode.  
            Press the Save button, and the system will create the shipment. If you now wish to create line(s) for this shipment, see the topic     Creating/Processing a Shipment Line for 
 further instructions. 
        
        NOTES: 
        
            The shipment's leading and trailing 
 status are determined by the status action value associated with the screen 
 that you're creating it on. 
            If you created this shipment on the Shipment Insight screen, its status is based on the value defined 
 in the "Add From Shipping" status action. 
            If you created this shipment on 
 the  Planned Shipment Insight screen, its status is based on the value 
 defined in the "Add From Wave" status action. 
            If you created this shipment 
 on the Order Entry Window, its status is based on the value defined in 
 the "Add From Order Entry" status action. 
        
         
        
         
         
        Editing a Shipment...
        
            Open the Shipment Insight Screen or the Planned Shipment Insight Screen.
            Access the shipment you want to edit.
            Select the Edit action. 
            Change the values of the field(s) you wish to edit. 
            Press the Save button The system will save your changes.
